# Setup

```{r setup}
# readxl reads the source data, binom gives Wilson confidence intervals,
# and openxlsx writes the final results workbook.
library(readxl)
library(binom)
library(openxlsx)

# Read the only worksheet used in the analysis.
data_file <- "mpox_dragonfly_tlid_Supplementary_data_Aug2026.xlsx"
data <- as.data.frame(read_excel(data_file, sheet = "Manuscript data"))
```

# Small repeated tasks

```{r}
yes_no <- function(x) {
  factor(x, levels = c("No", "Yes", "Unknown"))
}

# Format counts and percentages for the manuscript tables.
n_pct <- function(n, total) {
  sprintf("%d/%d (%.1f%%)", n, total, 100 * n / total)
}

# Format a median and interquartile range.
median_iqr <- function(x) {
  q <- quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
  sprintf("%.1f (%.1f-%.1f)", q[2], q[1], q[3])
}

# Use the same number formatting as the manuscript workbook.
pct <- function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * x)
p_value <- function(x) ifelse(x < 0.0001, "<0.0001", sprintf("%.4f", x))
or_ci <- function(or, low, high) sprintf("%.2f (%.2f to %.2f)", or, low, high)
difference_ci <- function(x, low, high) {
  sprintf("%.1f pp (%.1f to %.1f)", 100 * x, 100 * low, 100 * high)
}
```

# Diagnostic performance

```{r diagnostic-data}
# A target is qPCR positive when its Ct value is greater than 1.
ct_opxv <- as.numeric(data$`CT OPXV`)
ct_mpxv <- as.numeric(data$`CT MPXV`)
opxv_qpcr <- factor(ifelse(!is.na(ct_opxv) & ct_opxv > 1, "Positive", "Negative"),
                    levels = c("Negative", "Positive"))
mpxv_qpcr <- factor(ifelse(!is.na(ct_mpxv) & ct_mpxv > 1, "Positive", "Negative"),
                    levels = c("Negative", "Positive"))

# Translate the OPXV colour result into a positive/negative call.
opxv_dragonfly <- ifelse(
  data$`OPXV Colour` == "Positive (Yellow Colour)", "Positive",
  ifelse(data$`OPXV Colour` == "Negative (Pink Colour)", "Negative", NA)
)
opxv_dragonfly <- factor(opxv_dragonfly, levels = c("Negative", "Positive"))

# Translate the MPXV colour result. Invalid is negative here, as in the manuscript.
mpxv_dragonfly <- ifelse(
  data$`MPXV Colour` == "Positive (Yellow Colour)", "Positive",
  ifelse(data$`MPXV Colour` %in%
           c("Negative (Pink Colour)", "None of the above (Invalid)"),
         "Negative", NA)
)
mpxv_dragonfly <- factor(mpxv_dragonfly, levels = c("Negative", "Positive"))

# Rows are Dragonfly results and columns are qPCR results.
opxv_2x2 <- table(Dragonfly = opxv_dragonfly, qPCR = opxv_qpcr)
mpxv_2x2 <- table(Dragonfly = mpxv_dragonfly, qPCR = mpxv_qpcr)
```

```{r diagnostic-metrics}
# Calculate the five diagnostic measures with Wilson 95% confidence intervals.
diagnostic_metrics <- function(tab) {
  TP <- unname(tab["Positive", "Positive"])
  FP <- unname(tab["Positive", "Negative"])
  FN <- unname(tab["Negative", "Positive"])
  TN <- unname(tab["Negative", "Negative"])

  metric <- c("Sensitivity", "Specificity", "PPV", "NPV", "Accuracy")
  numerator <- c(TP, TN, TP, TN, TP + TN)
  denominator <- c(TP + FN, TN + FP, TP + FP, TN + FN, TP + FP + FN + TN)
  value <- character(length(metric))

  for (i in seq_along(metric)) {
    ci <- binom.confint(numerator[i], denominator[i], method = "wilson")
    value[i] <- sprintf("%.1f%% (%.1f-%.1f%%)",
                        100 * ci$mean, 100 * ci$lower, 100 * ci$upper)
  }

  data.frame(Metric = metric, Value = value, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

# Calculate OPXV and MPXV separately.
metrics_opxv <- diagnostic_metrics(opxv_2x2)
metrics_mpxv <- diagnostic_metrics(mpxv_2x2)

# Combine them for the printed and exported table.
diagnostic_summary <- rbind(
  data.frame(Target = "OPXV", metrics_opxv),
  data.frame(Target = "MPXV", metrics_mpxv)
)

diagnostic_summary
```

## Figure III

```{r diagnostic-figure, fig.width=12, fig.height=9}
# Draw one labelled 2 by 2 table.
draw_2x2 <- function(tab, title) {
  plot.new()
  plot.window(xlim = c(0.5, 2.5), ylim = c(0.5, 2.5))

  for (row in 1:2) {
    for (column in 1:2) {
      y <- 3 - row
      rect(column - 0.5, y - 0.5, column + 0.5, y + 0.5,
           col = "grey90", border = "grey50")

      cell <- if (row == 2 && column == 2) "TP" else
        if (row == 2 && column == 1) "FP" else
          if (row == 1 && column == 2) "FN" else "TN"

      text(column, y, paste0(cell, " = ", tab[row, column]), cex = 1.1)
    }
  }

  axis(3, at = 1:2, labels = c("qPCR NEG", "qPCR POS"), tick = FALSE)
  axis(2, at = 2:1, labels = c("DF NEG", "DF POS"),
       tick = FALSE, las = 1)
  title(main = title)
}

# Draw one Ct histogram and print its median, IQR and range.
draw_ct <- function(x, title) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  q <- quantile(x, c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75), names = FALSE)
  hist(x, breaks = 10, col = "grey85", border = "white",
       main = title, xlab = "Ct value")
  legend("topright",
         legend = c(sprintf("Median (IQR): %.1f (%.1f-%.1f)", q[2], q[1], q[3]),
                    sprintf("Range: %.1f-%.1f", min(x), max(x))),
         bty = "n", cex = 0.8)
}

# Print the five diagnostic estimates in one plain panel.
draw_metrics <- function(x, title) {
  plot.new()
  title(main = title)
  text(0.05, seq(0.82, 0.18, length.out = nrow(x)),
       paste0(x$Metric, ":  ", x$Value), adj = 0, cex = 0.95)
}

# Draw all six panels.
draw_diagnostic_figure <- function() {
  old <- par(mfrow = c(3, 2), mar = c(4, 5, 3, 1))
  on.exit(par(old))
  draw_2x2(opxv_2x2, "A. OPXV detection")
  draw_2x2(mpxv_2x2, "B. MPXV detection")
  draw_ct(ct_opxv, "C. OPXV Ct distribution")
  draw_ct(ct_mpxv, "D. MPXV Ct distribution")
  draw_metrics(metrics_opxv, "E. OPXV performance")
  draw_metrics(metrics_mpxv, "F. MPXV performance")
}

# Show the figure in the notebook.
draw_diagnostic_figure()
```

# Analysis data

```{r}
# Keep only the fields used in the remaining analysis.
analysis <- data.frame(
  case_id = as.character(data$`Sample ID`),
  age = as.numeric(data$Age),
  sex = as.character(data$Sex),
  pcr_result = factor(data$`PCR Result`, levels = c("Negative", "Positive")),
  dragonfly_result = factor(data$`Dragonfly Result`, levels = c("Negative", "Positive")),
  ct_opxv = ct_opxv,
  ct_mpxv = ct_mpxv,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Target-level Dragonfly calls used in the discordant-case figure.
analysis$dragonfly_opxv_result <- ifelse(
  data$`OPXV Colour` == "Positive (Yellow Colour)", "Positive",
  ifelse(data$`OPXV Colour` == "Negative (Pink Colour)", "Negative", "Unknown")
)
analysis$dragonfly_mpxv_result <- ifelse(
  data$`MPXV Colour` == "Positive (Yellow Colour)", "Positive",
  ifelse(data$`MPXV Colour` == "Negative (Pink Colour)", "Negative", "Unknown")
)

# Clinical fields used in the comparisons and discordant-case figure.
analysis$close_contact_mpox_case <- yes_no(data$`Close contact with a suspected or probable case of mpox`)
analysis$sexual_partner_last_21d <- yes_no(data$`Sexual partner in last 21 days`)
analysis$fever <- yes_no(data$`Symptom (Fever)`)
analysis$swollen_lymph_nodes_symptom <- yes_no(data$`Symptom (swollen lymph nodes)`)
analysis$lesion_genital <- yes_no(data$`Lesions (genital)`)
analysis$mucosal_involvement <- yes_no(data$`Mucosal involvement`)
analysis$rash_maculopapular <- yes_no(data$`Rash (maculopapular)`)
analysis$myalgia_symptom <- yes_no(data$`Symptom (myalgia)`)
analysis$fatigue_symptom <- yes_no(data$`Symptom (fatigue)`)

# For the heatmap, a present Ct is positive. A missing Ct is negative only
# when the overall PCR result is negative; otherwise it is unknown.
analysis$qpcr_opxv_result <- ifelse(
  !is.na(analysis$ct_opxv), "Positive",
  ifelse(analysis$pcr_result == "Negative", "Negative", "Unknown")
)
analysis$qpcr_mpxv_result <- ifelse(
  !is.na(analysis$ct_mpxv), "Positive",
  ifelse(analysis$pcr_result == "Negative", "Negative", "Unknown")
)

# Invalid MPXV colour is negative for the concordance calculation.
mpxv_positive <- ifelse(
  data$`MPXV Colour` == "Positive (Yellow Colour)", "Yes",
  ifelse(data$`MPXV Colour` %in%
           c("Negative (Pink Colour)", "None of the above (Invalid)"),
         "No", NA)
)

# Put each case into one of the four manuscript concordance groups.
analysis$concordance_group <- NA_character_
analysis$concordance_group[analysis$pcr_result == "Negative" & mpxv_positive == "No"] <- "Concordant negative"
analysis$concordance_group[analysis$pcr_result == "Positive" & mpxv_positive == "Yes"] <- "Concordant positive"
analysis$concordance_group[analysis$pcr_result == "Negative" & mpxv_positive == "Yes"] <- "Discordant Dragonfly+ / PCR-"
analysis$concordance_group[analysis$pcr_result == "Positive" & mpxv_positive == "No"] <- "Discordant Dragonfly- / PCR+"

# Inferential comparisons use only concordant negatives and concordant positives.
case_control <- analysis[analysis$concordance_group %in%
                           c("Concordant negative", "Concordant positive"), ]
case_control$pcr_result_label <- factor(
  ifelse(case_control$concordance_group == "Concordant positive", "Positive", "Negative"),
  levels = c("Negative", "Positive")
)

# Keep discordant cases for their descriptive figure and export.
discordant <- analysis[grepl("Discordant", analysis$concordance_group), ]
```

# Table I

```{r table-1}
# These are the profession groups printed in the manuscript table.
profession_levels <- c(
  "Student", "Builder", "Driver", "Farmer", "Fisherman", "Food vendor",
  "Health worker", "Housewife", "Market vendor", "Mechanic",
  "Merchandise vendor", "Sex worker"
)

# Profession and exposure labels have already been standardised in the Excel file.
profession <- as.character(data$Profession)
exposure <- as.character(data$`Reported exposure`)

# Assemble the few fields needed for Table 1.
sex <- as.character(data$Sex)
sex[is.na(sex) | !sex %in% c("Female", "Male")] <- "Unknown"

table1_data <- data.frame(
  pcr_result = as.character(data$`PCR Result`),
  sex = sex,
  age = as.numeric(data$Age),
  profession = profession,
  exposure = exposure,
  international = yes_no(data$`International in the last 21 days?`),
  district = yes_no(data$`Province/district travel in the last 21 days?`),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Use the manuscript age groups.
table1_data$age_group <- ifelse(
  is.na(table1_data$age), "Missing age",
  ifelse(table1_data$age <= 4, "Infant (<=4 years)",
         ifelse(table1_data$age <= 14, "Child (5 to <=14 years)",
                "Adult (>=15 years)"))
)

# Make the two Table 1 columns.
all_cases <- table1_data
positive_cases <- table1_data[table1_data$pcr_result == "Positive", ]
all_heading <- paste0("All suspected cases (n=", nrow(all_cases), ")")
positive_heading <- paste0("MPXV PCR positive (n=", nrow(positive_cases), ")")

# Make one row, then one counted row, using the full column denominators.
make_row <- function(label, all_value = "", positive_value = "") {
  answer <- data.frame(label, all_value, positive_value,
                       stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE)
  names(answer) <- c("Characteristic", all_heading, positive_heading)
  answer
}

count_row <- function(variable, level, label = level) {
  all_n <- sum(as.character(all_cases[[variable]]) == level, na.rm = TRUE)
  positive_n <- sum(as.character(positive_cases[[variable]]) == level, na.rm = TRUE)
  make_row(label,
           n_pct(all_n, nrow(all_cases)),
           n_pct(positive_n, nrow(positive_cases)))
}

# Exposure rows in the manuscript table.
exposure_levels <- c(
  "Household contact", "Sexual exposure", "Contact with symptomatic person at event",
  "Contact with clothes or other objects from a symptomatic person",
  "No reported exposure", "Unknown exposure", "At workplace", "Guest house"
)

# Build Table 1 in its printed order.
table1 <- rbind(
  make_row("Sex"),
  count_row("sex", "Female"),
  count_row("sex", "Male"),
  count_row("sex", "Unknown", "Missing/unknown"),

  make_row("Age"),
  make_row("Known age, n (%)",
           n_pct(sum(!is.na(all_cases$age)), nrow(all_cases)),
           n_pct(sum(!is.na(positive_cases$age)), nrow(positive_cases))),
  make_row("Median (IQR), years", median_iqr(all_cases$age), median_iqr(positive_cases$age)),
  do.call(rbind, lapply(c("Infant (<=4 years)", "Child (5 to <=14 years)",
                         "Adult (>=15 years)", "Missing age"),
                        function(x) count_row("age_group", x))),

  make_row("Profession*"),
  do.call(rbind, lapply(profession_levels, function(x) count_row("profession", x))),
  make_row("Other/unknown",
           n_pct(sum(all_cases$profession == "Other"), nrow(all_cases)),
           n_pct(sum(positive_cases$profession == "Other"), nrow(positive_cases))),

  make_row("Reported exposure**"),
  do.call(rbind, lapply(exposure_levels, function(x) count_row("exposure", x))),

  make_row("Travel in previous 21 days"),
  count_row("international", "Yes", "International"),
  count_row("district", "Yes", "Another district or province"),
  make_row(
    "Missing/unknown travel response",
    n_pct(sum(all_cases$international == "Unknown" |
                all_cases$district == "Unknown"), nrow(all_cases)),
    n_pct(sum(positive_cases$international == "Unknown" |
                positive_cases$district == "Unknown"), nrow(positive_cases))
  )
)

table1
```

# Supplementary Table I

```{r}
# Variables included in the analysis.
binary_labels <- c(
  close_contact_mpox_case = "Close contact with suspected/probable mpox case",
  sexual_partner_last_21d = "Sexual exposure in prior 21 days",
  fever = "Fever",
  swollen_lymph_nodes_symptom = "Swollen lymph nodes",
  lesion_genital = "Genital lesions",
  mucosal_involvement = "Mucosal involvement",
  rash_maculopapular = "Maculopapular rash",
  myalgia_symptom = "Myalgia",
  fatigue_symptom = "Fatigue"
)

group <- case_control$pcr_result_label

analyse_variable <- function(variable) {
  value <- as.character(case_control[[variable]])
  keep <- !is.na(group) & value %in% c("No", "Yes")

  tab <- table(
    factor(group[keep], levels = c("Negative", "Positive")),
    factor(value[keep], levels = c("No", "Yes"))
  )

  yes <- tab[, "Yes"]
  total <- rowSums(tab)
  prevalence <- yes / total
  fisher_result <- fisher.test(tab, conf.int = TRUE)
  proportion_result <- suppressWarnings(
    prop.test(yes[c("Positive", "Negative")],
              total[c("Positive", "Negative")], correct = FALSE)
  )

  data.frame(
    variable = variable,
    label = unname(binary_labels[variable]),
    n_negative = unname(total["Negative"]),
    negative_yes = unname(yes["Negative"]),
    prevalence_negative = unname(prevalence["Negative"]),
    n_positive = unname(total["Positive"]),
    positive_yes = unname(yes["Positive"]),
    prevalence_positive = unname(prevalence["Positive"]),
    difference = unname(prevalence["Positive"] - prevalence["Negative"]),
    difference_low = unname(proportion_result$conf.int[1]),
    difference_high = unname(proportion_result$conf.int[2]),
    p_difference = proportion_result$p.value,
    odds_ratio = unname(fisher_result$estimate),
    odds_ratio_low = unname(fisher_result$conf.int[1]),
    odds_ratio_high = unname(fisher_result$conf.int[2]),
    p_odds_ratio = fisher_result$p.value
  )
}

binary_results <- do.call(
  rbind, lapply(names(binary_labels), analyse_variable)
)

binary_results$p_difference_fdr <- p.adjust(
  binary_results$p_difference, method = "BH"
)
binary_results$p_odds_ratio_fdr <- p.adjust(
  binary_results$p_odds_ratio, method = "BH"
)

binary_results_print <- data.frame(
  Variable = binary_results$label,
  `PCR-negative / concordant negative` = sprintf(
    "%d/%d (%.1f%%)", binary_results$negative_yes,
    binary_results$n_negative, 100 * binary_results$prevalence_negative
  ),
  `PCR-positive / concordant positive` = sprintf(
    "%d/%d (%.1f%%)", binary_results$positive_yes,
    binary_results$n_positive, 100 * binary_results$prevalence_positive
  ),
  `Prevalence difference (positive minus negative)` = difference_ci(
    binary_results$difference, binary_results$difference_low,
    binary_results$difference_high
  ),
  `FDR-adjusted P value for prevalence difference` = p_value(
    binary_results$p_difference_fdr
  ),
  `Odds ratio (95% CI)` = or_ci(
    binary_results$odds_ratio, binary_results$odds_ratio_low,
    binary_results$odds_ratio_high
  ),
  `FDR-adjusted P value for odds ratio` = p_value(
    binary_results$p_odds_ratio_fdr
  ),
  check.names = FALSE
)

binary_results_print
```


# TABLE IV

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
# These are the columns shown in the discordant-case figure.
feature_key <- data.frame(
  feature = c(
    "dragonfly_opxv_result", "dragonfly_mpxv_result",
    "qpcr_opxv_result", "qpcr_mpxv_result",
    "close_contact_mpox_case", "sexual_partner_last_21d", "fever",
    "lesion_genital", "rash_maculopapular", "mucosal_involvement",
    "swollen_lymph_nodes_symptom"
  ),
  label = c(
    "DF OPXV", "DF MPXV", "qPCR OPXV", "qPCR MPXV", "MPXV contact",
    "Sexual exposure", "Fever", "Genital lesion", "Maculopapular rash",
    "Mucosal involvement", "Lymphadenopathy"
  ),
  domain = c(rep("Diagnostic", 4), rep("Clinical", 7)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Draw one basic labelled heatmap panel.
draw_discordant_panel <- function(x, title) {
  x <- x[order(x$age, x$case_id), ]
  n_cases <- nrow(x)
  n_features <- nrow(feature_key)

  plot(NA, xlim = c(0.5, n_features + 0.5), ylim = c(0.5, n_cases + 0.5),
       axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "", main = title)

  for (i in seq_len(n_cases)) {
    y <- n_cases - i + 1

    for (j in seq_len(n_features)) {
      value <- as.character(x[[feature_key$feature[j]]][i])
      if (is.na(value)) value <- "Unknown"

      # Diagnostic and clinical tiles use separate simple colour pairs.
      colour <- "grey85"
      if (feature_key$domain[j] == "Diagnostic" && value == "Positive") colour <- "dimgray"
      if (feature_key$domain[j] == "Diagnostic" && value == "Negative") colour <- "gainsboro"
      if (feature_key$domain[j] == "Clinical" && value == "Yes") colour <- "grey"
      if (feature_key$domain[j] == "Clinical" && value == "No") colour <- "whitesmoke"

      # Short label printed inside the tile.
      label <- ifelse(value == "Positive", "Pos",
                      ifelse(value == "Negative", "Neg",
                             ifelse(value == "Unknown", "Unk", value)))

      if (feature_key$feature[j] == "qpcr_opxv_result" && value == "Positive") {
        label <- paste0("Pos\n", sprintf("%.1f", x$ct_opxv[i]))
      }
      if (feature_key$feature[j] == "qpcr_mpxv_result" && value == "Positive") {
        label <- paste0("Pos\n", sprintf("%.1f", x$ct_mpxv[i]))
      }

      rect(j - 0.5, y - 0.5, j + 0.5, y + 0.5,
           col = colour, border = "white")
      text(j, y, label, cex = 0.65)
    }
  }

  # Label every feature and every case.
  axis(1, at = seq_len(n_features), labels = feature_key$label,
       las = 2, tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.75)
  case_label <- paste0(x$case_id, "  (age ", x$age, ")")
  axis(2, at = n_cases:1, labels = case_label,
       las = 1, tick = FALSE, cex.axis = 0.72)
  box()
}

# Draw the two discordant groups one above the other.
draw_discordant_figure <- function() {
  old <- par(mfrow = c(2, 1), mar = c(8, 9, 3, 1))
  on.exit(par(old))
  draw_discordant_panel(
    discordant[discordant$concordance_group == "Discordant Dragonfly+ / PCR-", ],
    "A. Dragonfly-positive / PCR-negative"
  )
  draw_discordant_panel(
    discordant[discordant$concordance_group == "Discordant Dragonfly- / PCR+", ],
    "B. Dragonfly-negative / PCR-positive"
  )
}

# Show the figure in the notebook.
draw_discordant_figure()
```
